CommentDto.description: Comment on a forum post, optionally with nested replies

status.description: Comment status; only VISIBLE and DELETED comments are listed

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details returned with every 4xx and 5xx response

errors.description: Messages by request field name; present when request validation fails or when a field causes the error, such as an email used by another account

title.description: Short summary of the problem type

type.description: Problem type URI; omitted for the default about:blank

displayName.description: Public display name; omit it to show the username instead

SearchResultsDto.description: Search results, one page per kind; a kind left out by the type filter is null

posts.description: Published and locked posts whose title or content contains the query, most recent activity first; navigate with the slug

query.description: The query as it was matched, without surrounding whitespace

tags.description: Tags in use whose name contains the query, most used first; navigate with the slug

users.description: Active users whose username or display name contains the query, by username; navigate with the username

postCount.description: Number of posts using this tag

TrendDataPointDto.description: A single data point in a time-series trend

count.description: Count of events on this date

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: Request body for updating a forum category; omitted fields stay as they are

description.description: New description; an empty string removes it

displayOrder.description: New position in the category list, lowest first

name.description: New category name, unique ignoring case

slug.description: New URL slug, unique; links with the old slug stop working

visible.description: Show or hide the category; hidden categories are left out of the public reads

UpdateCommentRequest.description: Request body for updating a comment

UpdatePostRequest.description: Request body for updating a post (all fields optional)

status.description: Change post status; LOCKED, and changes to a locked post, are reserved for moderators and admins

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Request body for updating own profile (all fields optional)

avatarUrl.description: New avatar URL — must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL; an empty string clears it

bio.description: New bio text; an empty string clears it

displayName.description: New display name; an empty string clears it

email.description: New email address — must not be blank or used by another account
